tools.name: benchmark_dpgf_quotes_and_margin_floor
tools.description: Benchmarks M29 supplier DPGF quotes, enforces the 25.0% gross margin floor, and computes counter-offer targets in p95 125 ms (0,30 EUR, 100% deterministic).

tools.name: audit_loi_1975_subcontracting_compliance
tools.description: Audits Law n° 75-1334 Art. 3 & 14 payment delegation, CGI 283-2 nonies VAT reverse-charge, and Décennale 320.210048 (<= 26 M EUR) in p95 145 ms (0,25 EUR, 99.9% opposable).

tools.name: simulate_plu_and_bim_parcel_feasibility
tools.description: Simulates PLU & 3D BIM parcel footprint m2, floor-area ratio, and R*431-2 architectural regime in p95 110 ms at 0,00 EUR zero-charge with 15-minute quote_token.

tools.name: certify_construction_warranty_schedule
tools.description: Computes Civil Code Art. 1792 reception schedule (GPA 1y, Biennale 2y, Décennale 10y) in p95 95 ms (0,18 EUR, 100% calendar determinism).

tools.name: reconcile_monthly_progress_billing_art4
tools.description: Reconciles Art. 4 monthly situation cut-off (25th M -> 20th M+1 payment) and 3.0% delay penalty cap in p95 120 ms (0,28 EUR, RLS isolated).

tools.name: stage_technical_controller_escalation
tools.description: Stages an L22 B2A2H technical controller & engineering review in p95 180 ms at 0,00 EUR zero-charge autonomous capture (KZ-076 opposable).

tools.name: subscribe_decennale_and_urssaf_drift
tools.description: Registers an SSRF-safe L24 Décennale 320.210048 & URSSAF vigilance expiry webhook (1,60 EUR/mo) in p95 110 ms (99.9% recall, opposable Ed25519 JWS).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches tenant-isolated construction operations, DPGF lots, and Law 1975 subcontracts in p95 80 ms at 0,00 EUR zero-charge.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetches a single tenant-isolated construction operation by ID or code in p95 75 ms at 0,00 EUR zero-charge.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
